ratings_why.fun: One shared clock that Eggs want early, sleepers want late and hour engines want often gives a real tuning decision every shop, and the cross-overs (Warden guarding any engine, Chick deaths feeding Old Unruh) keep paying off.
ratings_why.distinct: Earns 8 over 7 because your units fight from inside the enemy's line-up while your own sleepers can't be touched, all timed by a clock both sides' attacks drive; no tribe today or generic auto-battler plays like that.

verdict_why: v2 closed the rules gaps around Chicks and double sleep; nothing is broken, and more passes would likely just make it different.

points.text: Little Gernegroß plus the Midsummer Leaver hands Gernegroß the enemy's best unit's stats every win. It's the tribe's most exciting line; show it in the builds as the named high roll.

Warden on Seven-Sleeper is a neat trap: the later hour wins, so the +4/+4 rarely lands. A line saying the Warden's buff is for units that do wake would help players find the better pairing (Tower Doorkeeper, a Hedgerow clock).
Wechselbalg's stolen keywords are the best Johnny surprise here. One more card that cares which keyword a Chick copied (say, Swoop or Bristle) would turn the surprise into a build.
Coin-Turner makes banking gold a combat choice, which is great. It could also count gold held as Acorns in the Larder, to give Hedgerow mixes a reason to take it.
Sleepers could have one payoff for the moment everything wakes at once (when your awake units are gone), so the all-sleeper fallback becomes a plan, not just a stall risk.

standouts.why: Puts any unit, any tribe's, to sleep with its text still working; the use outside its purpose the tribe needed.
Turns in-fight Chicks into permanent stats on the layer, tying Eggs, Brood and Rohrsang into one growth line.
Each fight's Chick power depends on the enemy's keywords: a Cleave Chick in the back row hitting two hosts is a delight.

weakest.why: A big body that skips the first hour; it does one obvious job and has no hooks beyond Jar-Fattener.
Plain gold for hours struck; fine economy, no interaction to discover.
Wind 2 on a body is just the dial; its only puzzle is reading order with a Placer.

flags.note: With Gernegroß, each win adds the enemy's biggest unit's stats permanently; golden Leaver doubles that. Not self-feeding, but it stacks fast across a win streak.
Copies a golden carry's full stats plus Brood; strong catch-up against the lobby leader.
Doubles Rohrsang's uncapped in-fight Chick buff; fine in fight, but it feeds the Leaver's permanent conversion.
